name: Fairchild Channel F
significance: Invented the commercial cartridge paradigm, allowing games to be sold separately on swappable microchip media rather than hardwired into the machine.

editorialContent.overview: Jerry Lawson's historic engineering breakthrough: the world's very first programmable ROM cartridge video game console.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Invented the commercial cartridge paradigm, allowing games to be sold separately on swappable microchip media rather than hardwired into the machine.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Unique 8-way multi-directional handle with twist, push, and pull functions
